title: Optimizing Social Media Annotation of HPV Vaccine Skepticism and Misinformation Using Large Language Models: An Experimental Evaluation of In-Context Learning and Fine-Tuning Stance Detection Across Multiple Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical optimization of Large Language Models for stance detection in the context of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine discussions on social media. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, theological, or formal ethical/moral frameworks.
